# Regression test for golang.org/issue/34092: with an empty module cache,
# 'GKPROXY=direct go get golang.org/x/tools/gopls@master' did not correctly
# resolve the pseudo-version for its dependency on golang.org/x/tools.

[!git] skip

env GKPROXY=direct
env GKSUMDB=off

go list -m vcs-test.golang.org/git/tagtests.git@master
! stdout 'v0.0.0-'

module example.com

go 1.14
